english: I'm the doctor, I'm going to check your eyes.
Does it hurt? Point to where.
target: هل تشعر بألم؟ أشر إلى مكانه.
romanisation: Hal tash'ur bi-alam? Ashir ilâ makânih.

english: Please read the smallest line you can see.
Tell me if you see the light move.
Do you see two of me?
Is it worse looking this way?
target: هل يزداد سوءاً عند النظر هكذا؟

english: Look at my finger. Don't move your head.
target: انظر إلى إصبعي. لا تحرك رأسك.
romanisation: Unzur ilâ isba'î. Lâ tuharrik ra'sak.

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
target: هل لديك حساسية من أي دواء؟
romanisation: Hal ladayk hassâsiya min ayy dawâ'?

english: I'm going to put drops in your eye.
This is an analgesic for your eyes. It may sting for a few seconds.
target: هذه قطرة مخدرة للعين. قد تسبب وخزاً لبضع ثوانٍ.
romanisation: Hâdhihi qatra mukhaddira lil-'ayn. Qad tusabbib wakhzan li-bid' thawân.

english: This drop will dilate your pupils.
Your vision will be blurry for about 6 hours.
target: ستكون رؤيتك ضبابية نحو ست ساعات.
romanisation: Satakûn ru'yatak dabâbiya nahwa sitt sâ'ât.

english: The light is bright. Please bear with it.
I'm going to touch your eyelid.
The exam is finished. Thank you.
We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
